claims.statement: In Evo2-7B's Layer-26 SAE, a non-empty set of features selectively marks α-helix codons, beyond confounds and multiple-testing chance (M0-gated existence claim).
claims.origin: task.md — given behavior, upstream half (existence/selectivity), validated by the M0 phenomenon-validation gate.

data.source: Natural CDS from RefSeq/Ensembl/ENA whose proteins have experimental PDB structures; per-residue DSSP labels mapped to codons via CDS↔protein alignment (no reverse-translation).
data.used_n: 648 E. coli / 181,359 codons + 350,268 H. sapiens codons (both established); cluster-split @30% identity, floor cleared with wide margin
data.subset_note: cross-organism replication COMPLETE — E. coli + H. sapiens both established

claims.method: Per-codon F1 + AUROC of each of ~32,768 SAE features vs DSSP helix label (HGI primary, H-only robustness); BH-FDR-controlled feature set S=19 with selectivity margin over β-sheet/coil; confound controls (length, codon/GC freq, position, coding, label identity).

main_experiment.key_stats: set AUROC 0.89 logistic / 0.88 unweighted-mean (overfit-proof); confound-only 0.50-0.53; shuffle-null ~0.50; 321-380 BH-FDR-sig features; best single feature 0.64 (<τ=0.75); f/28741 rank-0. DISCLOSURE (iteration ⓪): the plan's pre-registered seed-robustness stat seed_jaccard=0.0 is degenerate (computed on the always-empty strict single-feature set, not the steering set); the actual relaxed steering set's cross-seed Jaccard is ~0.7-0.8 (stable). Set-level AUROC-stability (0.88-0.90 across seeds/helix-defs) is the substantive robustness evidence.
main_experiment.headline: A distributed set of ~19 Layer-26 SAE features jointly detects α-helix codons — conditional set-level phenomenon (no single helix neuron; replicated across E. coli AND H. sapiens, set AUROC 0.86-0.89).

claims.statement: Amplifying the C1 α-helix feature set during autoregressive DNA generation increases the encoded-protein α-helix fraction, monotonically with amplification strength up to an optimum (dose-response).
claims.origin: task.md — given behavior, core causal claim (dose-response).

data.source: Evo2-7B steered autoregressive DNA generation → ORF translation → ESMFold structure prediction → DSSP α-helix fraction.
data.used_n: 110-150 generated/dose (165-257 folded-gated) × 8 doses × 3 seeds = 24 runs; > M1 power floor 101

claims.method: Dose-response sweep α∈{-2,0,1,2,4,8,16,32}; Spearman trend of mean DSSP helix fraction vs α; per-dose Mann–Whitney vs α=0; optimal α*; quality gate (valid-ORF, pLDDT, perplexity).

main_experiment.key_stats: Spearman ρ=0.759, p=1.7e-5; helix fraction 0.475(α=0)→0.834(α=32), effect +0.36; α*=32 (max), clean optimum α=8 (+0.10 at baseline quality); valid-ORF 0.87-0.89 (≤α8) / 0.65 (α16) / 0.78 (α32); pLDDT 57-80 (never collapses)
main_experiment.headline: Amplifying the α-helix feature set causally raises encoded-protein α-helix fraction — monotone dose-response with a threshold at α≈4, not a quality-collapse artifact.

iteration.final_reviewer_status: PASS held (reviewer: 'strongest part of the paper'); ⓪ paper caveats carried, no back-edge
iteration.narrowed_to: effect is on a structure-PREDICTOR proxy (ESMFold+DSSP) under one predictor pipeline — robust to SS-assignment choice, not yet to the structure predictor itself

claims.final_status: ✓ supported + verify PASS — robust to SS-assignment axis (pydssp reproduces dose-response ρ=0.886, effect +0.327 vs mkdssp +0.332). ⓪ paper caveats carried (see caveats). Scope: structure-predictor axis untested this pass.
caveats: PROXY readout: effect measured via ESMFold-predicted structure + DSSP on generated sequences, not experimental structure — frame as causal effect on a predicted structural phenotype under one structure-prediction pipeline, not biological ground truth

structure-PREDICTOR swap axis (ESMFold→OmegaFold) untested (network-infeasible this pass) — helix enrichment could partly exploit ESMFold inductive biases; robust only to the SS-assignment axis (pydssp)
α*=32 is a grid EDGE (helix still rising) — not a mapped interior plateau; report as such
valid-ORF dips to 0.65 at α=16 then recovers 0.78 at α=32 — non-monotone quality degradation, discuss explicitly; clean operating point α=8 (+0.10, baseline quality)

figures.caption: Dose-response: amplifying the α-helix feature set monotonically raises encoded-protein α-helix fraction from 0.48 (baseline) to 0.83 (α=32), Spearman ρ=0.76, p=1.7e-5; clean-quality optimum at α=8.
Capability control: valid-ORF rate holds at or above baseline (0.872) through α=8 and dips only at α≥16, confirming α=8 as the clean-quality optimum.

claims.statement: The amplification-induced α-helix rise is specific to the α-helix feature set — matched-control and β-sheet off-target features do not reproduce it (double dissociation) and generation quality is preserved — establishing the feature set as a causally manipulable knob.

data.source: Steered generation across feature kinds (α-helix S vs matched-control vs β-sheet off-target) → ESMFold → DSSP (helix + sheet readout).
data.used_n: 3 feature kinds × 4 α × 3 seeds = 36 runs (full grid)

claims.method: Double dissociation: S raises helix-not-sheet; β-sheet feature vs sheet-not-helix; matched-control raises neither; interaction/gap statistics; quality guardrails (coding fraction, valid-ORF, perplexity, pLDDT).

main_experiment.key_stats: FIXED (iteration ②): decisive dose re-locked α=16→α=8 (capability-preserved, valid-ORF 0.888 vs 0.667). At α=8: S helix +0.096 vs baseline; matched −0.003, β −0.010 (flat). PRIMARY random-direction null (N=33, norm-matched): S beats all 33 (0/33≥S), empirical p=0.029, z=3.02, capability matched (S valid-ORF 0.888 ≈ random 0.887). Secondary matched-control Mann-Whitney p=3.5e-4. β-amplification arm NEGATIVE (Δsheet +0.005) — reported honestly. [Superseded prior α=16 stat: S helix +0.285, S≫matched p≤3e-23 at a capability-crashed dose.]
main_experiment.headline: At a capability-preserved dose (α=8), amplifying the α-helix feature set S raises encoded-protein α-helix well beyond a 33-direction norm-matched random null (p=0.029, z=3.0) and beyond matched-control — a specific, causally manipulable knob (helix-axis specificity; β-amplification arm is a documented negative result, not a symmetric double dissociation).
